images.what: Illustrative photo: Two large black mesh panels in light wooden frames stand in a concrete hall, each printed with the diamond logo of the Dutch Design Awards, the letters D, D and A in a white diamond that looks mirrored through the mesh
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: Illustrative photo: A wide view of a low concrete hall with exposed pipes and gray steel frames over tables, a tall dark blue wall at the center, a round paper book and a gray box on a table in the foreground, white mannequins and a monitor in the middle distance, a video screen at the far left and a dark cube with a screen at the right
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: A white panel on a gray steel post, headed COLOFON in red, with columns of small printed names in Dutch and English grouped by Product, Fashion, Communication, Service & Systems, Habitat, Design Research, Young Designer, Best Client, BNO Piet Zwart Award and International Jury, then the exhibition designer La Bolleur, the collaboration with Exposize, the initiator Gemeente Eindhoven, partners and media partners

images.what: A tall red sign reading FRAME public award in white tilts across a wooden frame with the black letters VOTE NOW at the left
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: A tall wooden voting shelf under a red sign reading FRAME public award, with the black letters VOTE NOW above it, seen from the side
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: On a white board set in a gray steel frame, three round lamps with black rims glow with concentric, grid and hexagon patterns, with black cords hanging down
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: A round book made of dozens of white pages fanned in a full circle stands on a black base on a white table with a red edge
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: Illustrative photo: Looking through a gray steel frame into a low concrete hall, with a tall dark blue wall at the left, white mannequins in a beige coat and a cream gown at the center, a monitor, stacks of red shopping carts and a sign reading YOUNG DESIGNER AWARD in red at the right, on a pale floor with a pink circle
images.credit: Photo: Bo van Veen/Dutch Design Week

images.what: Illustrative photo: A gray steel frame in a dark concrete hall holds a white board with round holes at the center and a mirrored mountain-shaped piece in amber, at the right

images.what: Illustrative photo: A dim concrete hall with a glowing projection screen at the left that shows an orange and white image of a hooded figure, the name DAAN NOPPEN and the title ETRO ANIME SEE THE SOUND, tall dark banners lined with white company names, and at the back a gray curtain whose mirrored letters read BACK TO THE FUTURE in orange, white and green rosettes

A white curtain hung in a concrete hall carries the words BE THE FUTURE in angular letters built of orange, lilac, mint and black diamond shapes with the letters DDA. At the right, about ten visitors stand in dark silhouette between yellow pillars, with white banners and a blue-lit wall behind them
In a dim concrete hall, a tall white banner headed INTRODUCTION with the line The best of Dutch design hangs at the left, and a second text banner beside it
Illustrative photo: Four faceted diamond-shaped trophies built of small cut pieces with the letters DDA stand on colored pyramid bases stamped 2017, lit in purple against a black background

A green-headed board titled VLUCHTMAAT with a diagram, a monthly budget table and eight small photographs of rooms stands in front of a corrugated cardboard plinth, with a white banner showing a projected image of travelers in a station hall at the right and the Habitat banner at the back
A bright concrete hall with yellow pillars and white banners, one headed FASHION and another with text for the Sies Marjan autumn-winter collection 2017

Close view of diamond-shaped metal trophies with the letters DDA on pyramid bases, an orange one stamped PRODUCT 2017, a blue one stamped COMMUNICATION 2017, a green one and a black one marked PUBLIC AWARD, on a white table against a black background with blue blurred lights

Two adult visitors in dark coats, seen from behind, lean over white plinths printed with orange, teal and purple DDA shapes in front of a lilac curtain with the same pattern, beside a white banner headed COLOPHON that lists committees

Illustrative photo: A white curtain printed with angular diamond letters stands at the right, with a dark gray curtain at the left printed BACK TO THE FUTURE in white, orange and teal rosettes, in a bare concrete hall

Illustrative photo: A corridor between two printed curtains, a white one with the words BE THE FUTURE at the left and a dark one with BACK TO THE FUTURE at the right, with about ten adult visitors at mid distance, one in a black and white patterned suit, in a hall of white banners behind

images.what: Illustrative photo: A former factory hall with a yellow-painted concrete column at the left and walls of open cardboard cubbies held by wooden beams

Cardboard boxes stacked in two groups carry blue tape letters that read, across both stacks, collaboration between disciplines is crucial to understand the world and the urgencies that currently face our cities, signed LILET BREDDELS. Below, four small tablets in black frames show interview videos of four people, with a pair of headphones in a cardboard cubby beneath each

In a hall with yellow-painted pillars, two cardboard-framed boards on a black cardboard column read JORIS LAARMAN LAB X MX3D and MX3D Bridge in Dutch and English, numbered 14, with a photograph of the bridge print at the right

Three navy bench chairs stand in front of a concrete wall under tall factory windows, with white laundry baskets on two wooden stools and on the floor, and two large plaid bags printed with a name ending in WASSALON. A framed print above shows about seven people standing in a laundromat among washing machines and baskets
A board in a cardboard frame on a black cardboard column reads OLIVIER VAN HERPT, Portfolio, numbered 19, with Dutch and English text and photographs of a ceramic vase

Against a wall of open cardboard cubbies stand a red-handled broom, a bristle broom and a beige work apron hanging from a hook, with a screen on a low platform showing two women standing side by side against white, with partly legible text beginning SOCIALLAB. Two framed black-and-white group prints hang on the shelves, and at the right two boards in cardboard frames read SOCIAL LABEL, Social Label X Diverse Designers, numbered 11

Six posters of striped letters, in black and white, purple and yellow, red and pink, and navy and teal, hang on a cardboard shelf wall, with folded patterned fabrics on shelves between them, a glass vitrine on a gray wooden table holding red printed sheets, and a screen at the right that reads LOWLANDS 2018

Illustrative photo: A large brown board stands against a concrete wall with two blue crossing lines and the words misunderstood at the top left, urgent at the top right, hyped at the bottom left and promising at the bottom right, covered in many small colored cards in blue, purple, green and orange with handwritten notes

Illustrative photo: A wall of cardboard cubbies and a dark gray cardboard brick column hold two pendant lamps, one white and one brown with wooden strips, blue-and-white painted plates, bowls and a jug on a gray pallet, two black-and-white group photographs pinned among the shelves and one lying at the lower left, and a cardboard plinth with a yellow box
